class.name: FellowContactSound3D
class.brief_description: A body's sound from its own vibration when it strikes, slides or rolls: modal synthesis, no samples.
class.description: Milestone 180 ([code]docs/decisions/0322-contact-sound.md[/code]). A child of a [RigidBody3D]: the body is heard where it is, from its contacts (the node raises the body's [member RigidBody3D.max_contacts_reported] to 8). The body's modes come from its collision shapes' size, [member material] and [member wall_thickness] — a beam's bending for a long body (a rod, a pipe, a plank), plates' bending for a slab or each pair of a hollow box's walls, a ring's for a can or a bottle — their decay from the material's loss factor (wood a fraction of a second, metal seconds). A strike drives them with the contact's force: a half-sine as long as the Hertzian contact lasts (hard on hard short and bright, rubber long and dull), weighted by each mode's shape where it lands (a plank struck in its middle lacks its second mode); the body's own sudden slowing radiates a click (what a small stone is heard as). Sliding drives the modes with the surfaces' roughness passing under the contact, rolling likewise but smoother; resting on something damps them. Level: full scale is 120 dB SPL at a metre; [member sound_unit_size] places that distance. A child of a [StaticBody3D] (or any collision object) only gives its material to what strikes it (a floor, a table); colliders without one are [member ground_material]. Pieces of a [FellowDestructible3D] whose body has one sound like it. Voices: an [AudioStreamPlayer3D] while the body sounds (started when it moves fast near the listener, so the first strike is not late), stopped three seconds after it falls quiet; at most 24 at once. Not in the editor.

method.name: debug_render
method.description: The body's sound offline (tests and tuning, [code]benchmarks/tools/world_sound/impact_sound.gd[/code]): [param events] by time, each a [Dictionary] — [code]{time, kind: "impact", speed, other, position, mass, held}[/code] (a strike closing at [code]speed[/code] m/s against the material [code]other[/code], at [code]position[/code] in the body's space; [code]held[/code]: ringing free after it), [code]{time, kind: "slide"}[/code] or [code]"roll"[/code] with [code]speed[/code] and [code]other[/code], [code]{time, kind: "rest"}[/code], [code]{time, kind: "free"}[/code]. Returns [code]samples[/code] (interleaved stereo, the same in both), [code]modes[/code] (as [method get_modes]), [code]strikes[/code], [code]contact_durations[/code] and [code]clicks[/code] (each strike's, seconds and full scale) and [code]usec_per_second[/code].

method.name: get_ground
method.description: What a foot on this body stands on (milestone 181, [FellowFootsteps3D]): [member surface] if set, else the [member material]'s floor — wood a wooden floor, metal a steel deck, stone stone, glass, plastic and ceramic tiles, rubber a mat (a [enum FellowFootsteps3D.Ground]).

method.name: get_modes
method.description: The body's modes, lowest first: dictionaries [code]{frequency, decay, gain}[/code] (Hz, the amplitude's decay a second, full scale for 1 m/s of the mode's velocity).

method.name: get_sound_stats
method.description: [code]playing[/code], the [code]modes[/code], [code]impacts[/code] (strikes found), [code]dropped[/code] (strikes not heard: no voice free), [code]sliding[/code] and [code]rolling[/code] (m/s now), [code]slid_seconds[/code] and [code]rolled_seconds[/code], [code]active_voices[/code] (all bodies'), the synthesis's [code]strikes[/code] and [code]peak[/code], [code]mixed_seconds[/code] and [code]mix_usec_per_second[/code].

members.member: The material of what the body strikes when that has no FellowContactSound3D of its own (the ground).
What the body is made of: its stiffness and density (the modes' frequencies), its loss factor (how long they ring), its hardness in a contact and how much it scrapes.
How many modes ring (the lowest; fewer for small debris).
The audio bus the body's sound plays on.
The body is heard. Off: no voice, no strikes found (the [signal impact] signal neither).
Beyond this distance from the listener the body is not heard (its voice stops).
The distance (metres) at which the body is heard at the level synthesised — the pressure at a metre; nearer louder, farther quieter ([member AudioStreamPlayer3D.unit_size]).
What a foot on this body stands on, for [FellowFootsteps3D] (a [enum FellowFootsteps3D.Ground]: a floor of gravel, a snowy roof); [code]-1[/code]: from [member material] (see [method get_ground]).

A hollow body's wall (metres): a crate's planks, a pipe's or a bottle's wall, a can's sheet; 0: solid. A hollow box rings in its walls and gives way under a blow (its click softer); a hollow round body rings round its shell.

signal.name: impact
signal.description: A strike: where (world), how fast the contact closed (m/s), against what. What a game uses to break things, to raise dust, to let guards hear.

constants.constant: Wood (along the grain): E 10 GPa, 600 kg/m³, loss factor 0.012.
Steel: E 200 GPa, 7850 kg/m³, loss factor 0.0004.
Stone, concrete: E 50 GPa, 2600 kg/m³, loss factor 0.005.
Glass: E 70 GPa, 2500 kg/m³, loss factor 0.0015.
Hard plastic: E 2.5 GPa, 1100 kg/m³, loss factor 0.03.
Rubber: E 10 MPa, 1100 kg/m³, loss factor 0.15.
Ceramic: E 100 GPa, 2400 kg/m³, loss factor 0.002.
